hypothesis: Giving each feature field a separate embedding per interacting field (instead of one shared embedding for all pairwise interactions), with a smaller k=4 to keep parameter count comparable to FM's k=16, will improve within-user ranking (valid primary) over the FM baseline because it lets e.g. user_id's 'toward video' vector differ from its 'toward author' vector -- this matches the verified result of valid 0.6025 vs FM 0.6016 over 6 seeds reported in prior analysis on this exact dataset/setup.
description: FFM with k=4 field-aware embeddings, replacing FM inside run_fm (reachable via --model fm), Adam optimizer kept, row-shuffled training (no batching change)
